name: Coefficient Spaces Under Disjunctive Product
statement: For nonempty proper classes, $\mathcal A(C\vee H)\simeq\mathcal A(C)\times\mathcal A(H)$ and $\min(1,\tau(C\vee H))=\max\{\min(1,\tau(C)),\min(1,\tau(H))\}$.
proof: The complement of the disjunctive product is $C^c\times H^c$. Apply stable complement duality and the Cartesian-product laws.
